groups.name: raf.kms
groups.description: Multi-cloud KMS (Key Management Service) and field encryption configuration.

groups.name: raf.kms.google.proxy
groups.description: Proxy configuration for Google Cloud KMS access.

properties.name: raf.kms.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the KMS field encryption integration.

properties.name: raf.kms.provider
properties.description: KMS provider to use. Determines which cloud SDK is used for key operations.

properties.name: raf.kms.key-id
properties.description: KMS master key ID (CMK). Used to encrypt/decrypt the data encryption key.

properties.name: raf.kms.data-key.mode
properties.description: Data key mode. Use 'KMS' to decrypt the cipher text via KMS, or 'LOCAL' to use a plaintext key directly.

properties.name: raf.kms.data-key.cipher-text
properties.description: KMS-encrypted data key ciphertext. Used when mode is 'KMS'.

properties.name: raf.kms.data-key.plain-text
properties.description: Plaintext data encryption key. Used when mode is 'LOCAL'. Not recommended for production.

properties.name: raf.kms.data-key.description
properties.description: Human-readable description of this data key.

properties.name: raf.kms.aliyun.region-id
properties.description: Alibaba Cloud region ID, e.g. cn-hangzhou.

properties.name: raf.kms.aliyun.access-key-id
properties.description: Alibaba Cloud AccessKeyId.

properties.name: raf.kms.aliyun.access-key-secret
properties.description: Alibaba Cloud AccessKeySecret.

properties.name: raf.kms.huawei.region
properties.description: Huawei Cloud region, e.g. cn-north-4.

properties.name: raf.kms.huawei.access-key
properties.description: Huawei Cloud AccessKey.

properties.name: raf.kms.huawei.secret-key
properties.description: Huawei Cloud SecretKey.

properties.name: raf.kms.huawei.project-id
properties.description: Huawei Cloud project ID.

properties.name: raf.kms.google.auth-mode
properties.description: Google Cloud authentication mode. 'ADC' uses Application Default Credentials; 'SERVICE_ACCOUNT' uses a service account JSON file.

properties.name: raf.kms.google.service-account-json-path
properties.description: Path to the Google service account JSON key file. Required when auth-mode is 'SERVICE_ACCOUNT'.

properties.name: raf.kms.google.proxy.enabled
properties.description: Whether to route Google KMS requests through a proxy.

properties.name: raf.kms.google.proxy.host
properties.description: Proxy host address.

properties.name: raf.kms.google.proxy.port
properties.description: Proxy port.

properties.name: raf.kms.google.proxy.username
properties.description: Proxy authentication username.

properties.name: raf.kms.google.proxy.password
properties.description: Proxy authentication password.

values.description: Decrypt the data key ciphertext via the KMS service on startup.
Use a plaintext data key directly. Suitable for development only.
Application Default Credentials (recommended for GKE/Cloud Run).
Explicit service account JSON key file.
